title: Keep every train-level acceptance well-formed

values: train file declaring an acceptances[] block
facts.note: Needs a YAML observer that detects presence (not change) of an acceptances[] block in a train file; existing unchanged blocks are selected too.
Validator runs confirm-blocking at CONFIRM over all selected train files.

fires: At CONFIRM, any train file under plan/_trains/ (flat or subject-nested) that declares an acceptances[] block, whether or not that block was changed
Planner adds or edits a train-level acceptance
Planner copies the documented exemplar to author a new train acceptance
doesNotFire: Train file with no acceptances[] block (the block is optional)

given: A train file under plan/_trains/ (flat or subject-nested) declares the optional acceptances[] block (WMBT acceptance shape); each entry contributes a derived repo rule via the rule-binding walker.
when: The planner authors, edits or keeps a train-level acceptance that is checked at CONFIRM.
then: Every train-level acceptance must be well-formed per the train-acceptance constraints (see prefer[0]).
prefer: Satisfy all four constraints: identity.urn matches the acc grammar (acc:<train-id>:<slug>); identity.purpose populated (becomes the rule description); identity.phase in RED|GREEN|SMOKE|REFACTOR; measurable via harness.type OR signal.metric+signal.threshold.

Copy the exemplar: identity {urn: acc:train:self-compliance:validate-lifecycle:idempotent-on-retry, id: AC-SMOKE-001, purpose: 'Re-running the train with the same idempotency key produces no duplicate side effects', phase: SMOKE}, harness {type: e2e}, signal {metric: duplicate_side_effects_on_retry, threshold: 0}.
Let the rule id derive: acc:<train-id>:<slug> -> repo.<train-id>.acc-<slug>.
avoid: id: at acceptance-block top level (rule id derives, §3.3).
disposition: anywhere in repo YAML (walker sets strict, §4.4).
Retired URN schemes or examples failing the acc grammar/train schema.
signal.metric without signal.threshold (or vice versa) as sole measurability.
why: Each acceptance becomes a derived repo rule the walker sets to strict; a bad URN, missing purpose/phase or unmeasurable block yields an unbindable or meaningless rule, so a confirm-blocking validator checks well-formedness.
evidence: On failure the validator reports train_file, acceptance_urn, constraint, detail.
The authorable exemplar itself satisfies the acc URN grammar, parses as a valid typed-train parent, and validates against the train schema's acceptance definition.
Every validator constraint has a fault-injection test; a clean baseline over an empty selection (no trains with acceptances) proves nothing.
verifier_detail: Family presence, template required_field_presence, variant planner_train_acceptances_wellformed, phase CONFIRM, enforcement confirm-blocking, subject_kind train_acceptance.
Selector: train files under plan/_trains/ (flat or subject-nested) declaring an acceptances[] block (presence, not change). Traversal: train file -> acceptances[] -> identity/harness/signal fields.

Constraints: identity.urn matches URNBuilder.PATTERNS['acc'] (train-acceptance shape); identity.purpose populated (becomes RuleMetadata.description); identity.phase populated (RED|GREEN|SMOKE|REFACTOR); EITHER harness.type OR (signal.metric AND signal.threshold) populated (measurability invariant §4.3).
Invariant: identity.urn matches the acc grammar, purpose and phase are populated, and the block is measurable via harness.type or signal.metric+threshold.
Excluded fields: id: at acceptance-block top level (rule-id derives mechanically, §3.3); disposition: anywhere in repo YAML (walker sets 'strict', §4.4).
rule_id derivation (spec v12 §3.3): acc:<train-id>:<slug> -> repo.<train-id>.acc-<slug>. Walker: atdd.coach.utils.rule_binding.find_repo_rules.
Failure evidence fields: train_file, acceptance_urn, constraint, detail.
Exemplar check: the authorable example must satisfy the acc URN grammar, parse as a valid typed-train parent, and validate against the train schema's acceptance definition.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; name 'Train-level acceptances'.
Terms: train_acceptance = an optional train-level acceptance; authorable_example (label 'The copy-paste train acceptance') = the exact train-level acceptance a human copies when authoring one.
source: legacy_path src/atdd/planner/conventions/train.convention.yaml, legacy_section acceptances, legacy_sha 825602729f11a3a4, extraction_mode high_fidelity.
parity: source_fragments_preserved true, examples_preserved true, implementation_preserved true, fix_hint_preserved false, reviewed_at 2026-07-29.

#1548: the node declared four constraints and bound nothing — no implementation, no validation block; the exemplar carried the URN scheme retired by #1421, so following the documentation produced an invalid artifact.

Now enforced by a real validator whose every constraint has a fault-injection test, because the real-repo baseline is 0 only for want of data (16 trains, 0 with acceptances; #1551 backfills), and a clean baseline over an empty selection proves nothing.
#1639: the authorable exemplar moved here from the deleted train.convention.yaml monolith.

sharedNodes.text: Strict disposition: the rule fails on every finding; no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: signal.metric without signal.threshold (or vice versa) as sole measurability.
additions.justification: Restates the source's 'signal.metric AND signal.threshold' measurability constraint as an anti-pattern; no new obligation.

additions.text: a bad URN, missing purpose/phase or unmeasurable block yields an unbindable or meaningless rule
additions.justification: Engineering reason inferred from the source statement that each acceptance becomes a derived rule (purpose becomes its description, id derives from the URN); no new obligation.

additions.text: fires/doesNotFire situations and fact observability notes.
additions.justification: Required by schema; derived from the source selector (presence of acceptances[] block, CONFIRM phase) and the optional nature of the block.

additions.text: Coder-facing text may slightly exceed ~1,000 characters because the source exemplar and the four constraints are kept in prefer.
